title: Kuiil
description: Ugnaught mechanic Kuiil was a vapor farmer on Arvala-7, when Din Djarin, The Mandalorian, traveled there in search of the Client's asset, he met Kuiil. Kuiil taught Djarin how to ride a blurrg and helped him repair the Razor Crest. Kuiil repaired IG-11 and the two joined Djarin. Kuiil died protecting Grogu from Imperial Biker Scouts.
